title: MXC config schema diff: vz containment backend (0.8.0-dev)
description: Additions to upstream schemas/dev/mxc-config.schema.0.8.0-dev.json for the Apple Virtualization.framework (vz) backend. The Containment definition gains the value "vz"; backend options live under experimental.vz, are optional, and default as annotated. Following the upstream experimental-block convention this object is permissive (no additionalProperties: false) — experimental backends are in flux. Using containment "vz" requires the experimental flag. v1 validation rejects UI access requests (ui.disable: false, ui.injection: true, ui.clipboard other than "none"), network.proxy, and non-empty network.blockedHosts; deniedPaths entries equal to or inside a shared path are rejected. See docs/macos-support/vz-backend.md.

containment.description: Containment backend selector (upstream 0.8.0-dev values). This diff adds "vz".

oneOf.description: Existing upstream values (abstract intents and concrete backends).
Apple Virtualization.framework micro-VM (experimental; added by this diff).

vz.description: Options for the vz backend. The whole object is optional; every field has a default. Permissive to unknown fields, matching the upstream experimental-block convention.

guestImagePath.description: Absolute path overriding the bundled guest image. Default: the image shipped alongside mxc-exec-mac.

cpuCount.description: Number of virtual CPUs for the guest VM.

bootTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for the guest agent to become reachable over vsock before failing the spawn.
